INSERT INTO gateway_log_hourly_agg (hour_bucket, app_id, client_id, total_calls, success_calls, fail_calls, total_tokens, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, cache_hit_tokens, cache_miss_tokens, apikey_auth_fail_count, violation_call_count, rate_limit_count, circuit_break_count) VALUES
(#{item.hourBucket}, #{item.appId}, #{item.clientId}, #{item.totalCalls}, #{item.successCalls}, #{item.failCalls}, #{item.totalTokens}, #{item.promptTokens}, #{item.completionTokens}, #{item.cacheHitTokens}, #{item.cacheMissTokens}, #{item.apikeyAuthFailCount}, #{item.violationCallCount}, #{item.rateLimitCount}, #{item.circuitBreakCount})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_calls = VALUES(total_calls), success_calls = VALUES(success_calls), fail_calls = VALUES(fail_calls), total_tokens = VALUES(total_tokens), prompt_tokens = VALUES(prompt_tokens), completion_tokens = VALUES(completion_tokens), cache_hit_tokens = VALUES(cache_hit_tokens), cache_miss_tokens = VALUES(cache_miss_tokens), apikey_auth_fail_count = VALUES(apikey_auth_fail_count), violation_call_count = VALUES(violation_call_count), rate_limit_count = VALUES(rate_limit_count), circuit_break_count = VALUES(circuit_break_count), updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT hour_bucket as hourBucket, app_id as appId, client_id as clientId, total_calls as totalCalls, success_calls as successCalls, fail_calls as failCalls, total_tokens as totalTokens, prompt_tokens as promptTokens, completion_tokens as completionTokens, cache_hit_tokens as cacheHitTokens, cache_miss_tokens as cacheMissTokens, apikey_auth_fail_count as apikeyAuthFailCount, violation_call_count as violationCallCount, rate_limit_count as rateLimitCount, circuit_break_count as circuitBreakCount FROM gateway_log_hourly_agg WHERE hour_bucket >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{hours} HOUR)

SELECT hour_bucket as hourBucket, app_id as appId, client_id as clientId, total_calls as totalCalls, success_calls as successCalls, fail_calls as failCalls, total_tokens as totalTokens, prompt_tokens as promptTokens, completion_tokens as completionTokens, cache_hit_tokens as cacheHitTokens, cache_miss_tokens as cacheMissTokens, apikey_auth_fail_count as apikeyAuthFailCount, violation_call_count as violationCallCount, rate_limit_count as rateLimitCount, circuit_break_count as circuitBreakCount FROM gateway_log_hourly_agg WHERE hour_bucket BETWEEN #{startHour} AND #{endHour} AND app_id = '' AND client_id = ''

SELECT SUM(total_calls) AS total_calls, SUM(success_calls) AS success_calls, SUM(fail_calls) AS fail_calls, ROUND(SUM(success_calls) * 100.0 / SUM(total_calls), 1) AS success_rate FROM gateway_log_hourly_agg WHERE hour_bucket BETWEEN #{startHour} AND #{endHour} AND app_id = '' AND client_id = ''

SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_tokens) / 1000000, 1) AS total_tokens_m, ROUND(SUM(prompt_tokens) / 1000000, 1) AS prompt_tokens_m, ROUND(SUM(completion_tokens) / 1000000, 1) AS completion_tokens_m, ROUND(SUM(cache_hit_tokens) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(cache_hit_tokens + cache_miss_tokens), 0), 1) AS cache_hit_rate FROM gateway_log_hourly_agg WHERE hour_bucket BETWEEN #{startHour} AND #{endHour} AND app_id = '' AND client_id = ''

SELECT ROUND(SUM(success_calls) * 100.0 / SUM(total_calls), 1) AS apikey_pass_rate, SUM(total_calls) AS total_requests, SUM(success_calls) AS success_requests, SUM(apikey_auth_fail_count) AS apikey_auth_fail_count, SUM(violation_call_count) AS violation_call_count, SUM(rate_limit_count) AS rate_limit_count, SUM(circuit_break_count) AS circuit_break_count, SUM(rate_limit_count + circuit_break_count) AS rate_limit_circuit_count FROM gateway_log_hourly_agg WHERE hour_bucket BETWEEN #{startHour} AND #{endHour} AND app_id = '' AND client_id = ''
